title: Ujwalam game capture plan
description: data/games/<game-id>/capture-plan.json: screens, events and outcomes still to be captured per mode. The W1 coverage tracker (services/clip/coverage.py) reads it and reports each item when it is captured; its state lives in the pack's gitignored local/ folder, never in this file. Cross-file checks (detector, mode, medal, match criteria): tools/game-validate.mjs.

version.description: File format version. 2 (W1): every item has `match`.

dedicatedCaptureCheck.description: Build step at which items still missing get a dedicated capture request.

detector.description: null when no detector exists yet.

medal.description: Event text in the catalogue of `detector`.

status.description: Planning status. The tracker never edits this file; live coverage is in local/coverage.json.

match.description: How the coverage tracker recognises the item. auto: the first detection that meets any `when` criterion captures the item. manual: detections that meet a criterion are only candidates; the user confirms the item with `coverage.py mark`. Criteria come only from existing detector, screen and medal definitions; the validator allows auto only when every position it relies on is a verified ROI or screen cue.

reason.description: manual only: why no measured cue can capture the item automatically.

when.description: Any criterion matching one detection is enough.

criterion.description: All present fields must hold for one detection (one detector event in one sampled frame).

detector.description: Detector id; must be the item's detector.

medal.description: Catalogue event the detection matched (M3-style medal list).

pattern.description: One of the detector's patterns: the detection text must match this pattern better than the detector's other patterns.

rois.description: Detector ROI ids; the detection box centre must lie inside one of them.

nameInRoi.description: true: a profile-name box (score >= the name threshold) has its centre in the same ROI as the detection.

nameMatched.description: The detector event's own nameMatched flag (end-screen name check, e.g. K1).

screen.description: Screen id in screens.json; the detection box centre must lie inside one of that screen's cue ROIs.

frameModes.description: The frame's HUD mode (g1_scan classify_frame) must be one of these; an unclassified frame never matches.
